description: Specialization lexicon. Each rule matches one or more word tokens in a catalog skill name and adds domain-specific artifacts, acceptance checks, risks, and parameters on top of the category profile. Rules are additive and deterministic: they are applied in file order and merged without duplicates.

matching.method: token-boundary substring match against the skill name, then against the skill id slug
matching.roles: role_rules match the same way as rules and are merged after them; they encode the evidence each responsibility type must produce (architect vs engineer vs reviewer vs packager)

artifacts.title: Per-tier visual comparison set with settings used
artifacts.purpose: Shows what each quality tier actually looks like.

checks.statement: Every shader or material variant renders correctly on each declared quality tier with no missing or pink material fallback
checks.evidence: captures per tier plus the variant list

risks.risk: A variant that works in the editor fails in a packaged build
risks.mitigation: Compile and capture every variant inside a packaged build, not only the editor

artifacts.title: Visibility, culling, and streaming policy sheet
artifacts.purpose: Defines how content is added and removed.

checks.statement: Streaming or culling transitions produce no visible pop or hitch beyond the declared threshold
checks.evidence: capture or timing log of the transition

risks.risk: Streaming hitches appear only on slower storage
risks.mitigation: Test transitions on the slowest declared storage class and record hitch times

artifacts.title: Audio middleware or engine routing map
artifacts.purpose: Shows where each sound is triggered and routed.

checks.statement: No audio event produces clipping at the master bus under the declared worst-case simultaneous playback
checks.evidence: master bus meter capture or loudness measurement

risks.risk: Platform-specific codec rejection silently drops sound
risks.mitigation: Enumerate delivered formats per platform and verify playback in a build on each target

artifacts.title: Authority and prediction model diagram
artifacts.purpose: States which peer owns each decision.

checks.statement: State reconciliation converges after simulated packet loss, jitter, and a late joiner
checks.evidence: chaos test output with loss and jitter values

risks.risk: Prediction and correction are visible as rubber-banding
risks.mitigation: Measure correction magnitude under simulated latency and tune smoothing thresholds

artifacts.title: Service contract and failure-mode table
artifacts.purpose: Defines what the client does when the service fails.

checks.statement: Client behavior with the service offline or slow is defined and does not lose local player progress
checks.evidence: offline and degraded-service test transcript

risks.risk: Service outage destroys local progress or blocks play entirely
risks.mitigation: Queue writes locally, retry with backoff, and design an offline-usable path

artifacts.title: Save schema with version field and migration table
artifacts.purpose: Keeps old saves loadable after updates.

checks.statement: Saves written by the previous release load in the current build, and corrupted saves fail safely without wiping progress
checks.evidence: save migration test output with fixture saves

risks.risk: A format change silently invalidates player saves
risks.mitigation: Version every save, keep fixture saves in the test suite, and test migration in both directions

artifacts.title: Input action table with per-device bindings
artifacts.purpose: Makes controls inspectable and rebindable.

checks.statement: Every gameplay action is reachable from every declared device and survives a full rebind cycle including restart
checks.evidence: input matrix plus persisted binding file

risks.risk: Rebound or non-default layouts are broken by hardcoded key checks
risks.mitigation: Route all input through named actions and test with a non-default layout

artifacts.title: Screen state table with entry, exit, and back behavior
artifacts.purpose: Prevents navigation dead ends.

checks.statement: Every screen is reachable and exitable with a single declared input on pointer and non-pointer devices
checks.evidence: navigation matrix capture

risks.risk: Navigation traps strand players in a menu
risks.mitigation: Define a back behavior for every screen and test the full path with each device type

artifacts.title: Locale matrix with completion status per locale
artifacts.purpose: Shows translation coverage per locale.

checks.statement: String coverage is complete for every declared locale and no runtime string concatenation bypasses the string table
checks.evidence: coverage report plus a scan for concatenated literals

risks.risk: Right-to-left layout mirrors icons incorrectly
risks.mitigation: Test a right-to-left pseudolocale and mirror only directional assets

artifacts.title: Decision model table (states, conditions, priorities)
artifacts.purpose: Makes AI decisions reviewable off-line.

checks.statement: Agents never enter an unrecoverable state in the scripted scenario suite and always fall back to a declared safe behavior
checks.evidence: scenario suite output with per-agent final states

risks.risk: AI decision cost scales badly with agent count
risks.mitigation: Budget decisions per frame and time-slice expensive reasoning

artifacts.title: Transition matrix (from, to, guard, side effects)
artifacts.purpose: Proves the state space is complete.

checks.statement: Every declared transition is reachable and every undeclared transition is blocked by a guard
checks.evidence: transition coverage report

risks.risk: Implicit transitions bypass guards and corrupt state
risks.mitigation: Route all state changes through one transition function and assert legality

artifacts.title: Constraint list and rejection strategy
artifacts.purpose: Defines what generated content must satisfy.

checks.statement: Generation is deterministic for a fixed seed and configuration across two runs on the same build
checks.evidence: hash comparison of two generated outputs

risks.risk: Global random state leaks between systems and breaks reproducibility
risks.mitigation: Inject one seeded generator per system and assert stream separation in tests

artifacts.title: Mass, scale, and collider specification per interactive object
artifacts.purpose: Keeps simulation comparable and stable.

checks.statement: Interaction behaves consistently across the declared frame-rate range with the documented fixed timestep
checks.evidence: comparison capture at each frame rate

risks.risk: Physics instability appears only at low frame rates or high speeds
risks.mitigation: Test extremes explicitly and cap applied forces

artifacts.title: Clip inventory with loop, events, and blend settings
artifacts.purpose: Documents every clip's contract.

checks.statement: Loops are seamless and declared events fire once per cycle in the recorded capture
checks.evidence: capture plus event log per clip

risks.risk: Retargeted clips lose contact points and foot sliding appears
risks.mitigation: Validate contact frames on the final rig and compare against the source clip

artifacts.title: Sprite and tile metrics sheet (pixels per unit, pivots, padding)
artifacts.purpose: Prevents inconsistent scale and seams.

checks.statement: Rendering is seam-free and pixel-consistent at integer and fractional zoom levels
checks.evidence: captures at each zoom level

risks.risk: Mixed pixels-per-unit values break collision alignment
risks.mitigation: Declare one unit convention and validate assets on import

artifacts.title: Device and runtime support matrix
artifacts.purpose: States which headsets and runtimes were actually verified.

checks.statement: The experience holds the declared frame rate on the actual target headset with comfort options enabled
checks.evidence: on-device capture with headset model and runtime version

risks.risk: Untested on physical hardware while claims of device support are made
risks.mitigation: Mark device checks as blocked-and-owner-assigned until a human runs them

artifacts.title: Per-target build and input differences sheet
artifacts.purpose: Records what actually differs per platform.

checks.statement: A build per declared target launches, reaches gameplay, and passes the same smoke path
checks.evidence: per-target build id plus smoke log

risks.risk: Platform-specific input or store requirement is discovered at submission
risks.mitigation: Map platform requirements to checks at project start and re-verify each milestone

artifacts.title: Test-to-risk traceability table
artifacts.purpose: Shows which risk each test covers.

checks.statement: The test run is deterministic and repeatable: the same build produces the same result on two consecutive runs
checks.evidence: two run logs with identical outcomes

risks.risk: Nondeterministic tests train the team to ignore failures
risks.mitigation: Seed random input, pin time, and quarantine flaky tests with a tracked owner

artifacts.title: Measurement protocol (scenario, hardware, settings, build id)
artifacts.purpose: Makes numbers comparable across runs.

checks.statement: The declared budget is measured on a fixed scenario and the result is stored with hardware and build id
checks.evidence: capture file plus its metadata header

risks.risk: Numbers are compared across different scenarios and mislead the team
risks.mitigation: Freeze the scenario and record hardware, settings, and build id with every measurement

artifacts.title: Environment lock (toolchain, SDK, engine version, hashes)
artifacts.purpose: Reproduces the build on another machine.

checks.statement: Two builds from the same commit and lock produce identical artifact hashes or a documented, explained difference
checks.evidence: artifact hash comparison from two clean builds

risks.risk: A build succeeds only on one configured machine
risks.mitigation: Build in a clean container or fresh agent and pin every tool version

artifacts.title: Trust boundary and attack surface table
artifacts.purpose: Focuses review on code reachable by untrusted input.

checks.statement: Untrusted input is validated at the boundary and cannot reach privileged operations without authorization
checks.evidence: negative input test results per boundary

risks.risk: A policy or privacy breach blocks release or causes legal exposure
risks.mitigation: Require a human compliance sign-off recorded in the approval ledger before submission

artifacts.title: Accessibility option inventory with default and range
artifacts.purpose: Records what options exist and their defaults.

checks.statement: Contrast meets the declared ratio target and every accessibility option persists across sessions
checks.evidence: contrast measurements plus persisted-settings proof

risks.risk: Color-only signalling excludes players and fails review
risks.mitigation: Pair every color cue with shape, text, or audio and verify in a monochrome capture

artifacts.title: Permission matrix per API namespace
artifacts.purpose: Defines what user content may call.

checks.statement: The API denies filesystem, network, and native access by default and the denial is proven by an escape-attempt test
checks.evidence: sandbox test output with attempted operations

risks.risk: A convenience API silently grants arbitrary code execution
risks.mitigation: Default-deny capabilities, expose a curated surface, and test escape attempts each release

artifacts.title: Original artifact hash manifest with preservation location
artifacts.purpose: Proves the original was not modified.

checks.statement: Original artifacts are copied, hashed, and preserved before any analysis or conversion touches them
checks.evidence: hash manifest plus read-only copy path

risks.risk: Irreversible loss of original data or unlawful handling of protected assets
risks.mitigation: Snapshot originals first and record legal clearance before conversion or distribution

artifacts.title: Source and sink table with rates per minute
artifacts.purpose: Makes inflation checkable numerically.

checks.statement: A simulated play model shows net currency within the intended band and no reward path that can be farmed without limit
checks.evidence: simulation output with the player model used

risks.risk: Reward loops enable farming that collapses the intended pacing
risks.mitigation: Simulate adversarial play patterns and add caps with visible feedback

artifacts.title: Branch graph with state flags per choice
artifacts.purpose: Shows what each choice changes.

checks.statement: Every choice writes only declared state flags and every referenced flag is later read by at least one branch or ending
checks.evidence: flag read and write audit output

risks.risk: Orphaned flags make choices feel meaningless
risks.mitigation: Audit flag reads and writes and delete or wire up dead flags

artifacts.title: Encounter and difficulty pacing curve
artifacts.purpose: Makes difficulty progression reviewable.

checks.statement: Each level beat has a stated teaching or testing purpose that is observable in a fresh-player playthrough
checks.evidence: playthrough notes with timestamps per beat

risks.risk: Difficulty spikes block progression for the median player
risks.mitigation: Record first-attempt success rate per encounter and tune outliers

artifacts.title: Version pin record with retrieval dates
artifacts.purpose: Shows which version each claim came from.

checks.statement: Every version-sensitive claim carries the exact version and an official source, and one claim is proven in a scratch project
checks.evidence: pin record plus scratch-project proof

risks.risk: Stale documentation guidance silently breaks a newer project
risks.mitigation: Pin, cite, and prove in a scratch project before applying to the repository

artifacts.title: Milestone definition-of-done with measurable outcomes
artifacts.purpose: Replaces opinion with checkable outcomes.

checks.statement: Each milestone has a testable definition of done and a named owner before work starts
checks.evidence: milestone table with owner and check ids

risks.risk: Milestones are declared done without measurable evidence
risks.mitigation: Attach a check id to every milestone outcome and refuse closure without evidence

artifacts.title: Input grammar or command surface specification
artifacts.purpose: Defines exactly what the tool accepts.

checks.statement: The tool reports a precise, actionable error for every malformed input in the negative test set instead of crashing
checks.evidence: negative test transcript with message per case

risks.risk: The tool corrupts or loses user work on malformed input
risks.mitigation: Validate before mutating state and write atomically with a recoverable backup

artifacts.title: Capability routing record with rejected alternatives
artifacts.purpose: Shows why this engine, language, and capability set were selected.

checks.statement: Identical inputs produce identical routing, plan ids, and artifact sets across two runs
checks.evidence: two run outputs compared field by field

risks.risk: Autonomous execution performs irreversible actions without a human decision
risks.mitigation: Default to dry run and require an approval ledger entry before any publish, delete, or credential action

artifacts.title: Ability and counter table (cost, cooldown, counter, telegraph)
artifacts.purpose: Makes combat readable and balanceable.

checks.statement: Every ability telegraphs before it resolves and every counter is achievable with the player's available kit
checks.evidence: combat matrix test notes per ability

risks.risk: Unavoidable damage makes combat feel unfair
risks.mitigation: Document a readable counter for every threat and verify reaction time windows

artifacts.title: Item schema with stack, weight, and effect rules
artifacts.purpose: Single definition for item behavior.

checks.statement: Item add, remove, stack, and split operations preserve total counts under the fuzz test
checks.evidence: property test output with seeds

risks.risk: Item duplication or loss through edge-case inventory operations
risks.mitigation: Fuzz inventory operations and assert conservation invariants

artifacts.title: Camera behavior specification (follow, damping, collision, FOV)
artifacts.purpose: Makes camera feel tunable and testable.

checks.statement: The camera never clips through declared solid geometry or leaves the playable bounds in the traversal test
checks.evidence: traversal test capture

risks.risk: Camera occlusion hides the player during critical moments
risks.mitigation: Add camera collision and transparency fallback, then test in tight spaces

artifacts.title: Bundle graph with chunking and lazy-load boundaries
artifacts.purpose: Controls first-load cost.

checks.statement: The built bundle runs from a static server with no console errors and no network calls to undeclared hosts
checks.evidence: console and network capture from the served build

risks.risk: WebGL context loss leaves the game in a black-screen state
risks.mitigation: Handle context loss and restore, and test by forcing a context loss event

artifacts.title: Interpreter and virtual environment specification
artifacts.purpose: Reproduces the runtime exactly.

checks.statement: The game runs with the pinned interpreter and dependencies in a fresh virtual environment and in the packaged runtime
checks.evidence: install log plus packaged-runtime version print

risks.risk: The development interpreter differs from the one bundled at release
risks.mitigation: Bundle the recorded interpreter version and print it at startup

artifacts.title: Toolchain and runtime dependency table
artifacts.purpose: Records the exact native environment.

checks.statement: The binary runs on a machine without the development toolchain and reports no missing runtime library
checks.evidence: launch log from a clean machine or container

risks.risk: Missing runtime redistributables break the game on player machines
risks.mitigation: Ship required redistributables and test on a clean image

artifacts.title: Assembly definition and package dependency map
artifacts.purpose: Shows compile boundaries and external packages.

checks.statement: Compilation succeeds in batchmode with the recorded editor version and zero console errors
checks.evidence: batchmode log tail with error count

risks.risk: Editor-only assumptions break player builds
risks.mitigation: Verify in a player build, and guard editor-only code with assembly or preprocessor boundaries

artifacts.title: C++ to Blueprint contract sheet
artifacts.purpose: Prevents logic split across two systems drifting apart.

checks.statement: A packaged Development build launches and completes the smoke path with no cook warnings about missing assets
checks.evidence: cook and launch log

risks.risk: Blueprint-only changes bypass review and version control merge hygiene
risks.mitigation: Document the notify and review policy for Blueprint assets and check in small increments

artifacts.title: Scene and resource dependency map
artifacts.purpose: Shows what each scene pulls in.

checks.statement: The project imports and runs headless at the pinned version with zero parse or script errors
checks.evidence: headless log with error count

risks.risk: Version-specific API guidance is applied to the wrong major version
risks.mitigation: Pin the version and verify each API in the pinned editor before use

artifacts.title: Platform limitation sheet (scripting, export, store)
artifacts.purpose: Records what the platform cannot do before design relies on it.

checks.statement: The platform's own tooling produces a runnable export at the recorded version
checks.evidence: tool output with version and artifact path

risks.risk: A required feature is impossible or paid-only on the chosen platform
risks.mitigation: Prove the feature in a stub before committing the design

artifacts.title: Review findings table (finding, severity, owner, status)
artifacts.purpose: Tracks defects to closure.

checks.statement: Every finding has a severity, an owner, and a resolution state, and no high-severity finding remains open at the gate
checks.evidence: findings export with status counts

risks.risk: Review findings are recorded but never resolved
risks.mitigation: Gate release on zero open high-severity findings and log resolutions

artifacts.title: MonoBehaviour lifecycle map (Awake, OnEnable, Start, Update, FixedUpdate, OnDisable) with what each method owns
artifacts.purpose: Capability-specific deliverable for this catalog skill.

checks.statement: Lifecycle work happens in the documented method: no gameplay logic in Update that belongs in FixedUpdate, and no subscription survives OnDisable
checks.evidence: lifecycle audit note plus a run with objects enabled and disabled repeatedly

risks.risk: Subscriptions and coroutines survive object disable and leak
risks.mitigation: Unsubscribe and stop coroutines in OnDisable and test enable/disable cycles

artifacts.title: ScriptableObject asset inventory with owning systems and edit-time vs runtime mutation rules
artifacts.purpose: Capability-specific deliverable for this catalog skill.

checks.statement: Shared ScriptableObject state behaves identically in the editor and in a player build, and runtime mutation does not persist to the asset
checks.evidence: editor run plus player build run of the same scene, with captured values

risks.risk: Runtime writes to shared ScriptableObject assets leak between play sessions
risks.mitigation: Snapshot mutable state per instance and verify in a player build

artifacts.title: Input action asset map with control schemes and per-device bindings
artifacts.purpose: Capability-specific deliverable for this catalog skill.

checks.statement: Every declared control scheme drives the same gameplay actions and rebinding persists across a restart
checks.evidence: player build input test per control scheme plus the persisted bindings file

risks.risk: Device switching drops input silently
risks.mitigation: Test hot-swapping devices mid-session and declare fallback schemes

artifacts.title: UI document hierarchy with USS class ownership and scaling mode per panel
artifacts.purpose: Capability-specific deliverable for this catalog skill.

checks.statement: Panels reflow without clipping at every declared aspect ratio and both UI Toolkit and UGUI panels coexist without input capture conflicts
checks.evidence: captures at each aspect ratio plus an input focus test

risks.risk: Two UI systems fight over pointer input and focus
risks.mitigation: Declare which system owns each screen and test pointer routing between them

artifacts.title: Animator and physics integration sheet (root motion authority, ragdoll toggles, fixed timestep)
artifacts.purpose: Capability-specific deliverable for this catalog skill.

checks.statement: Character movement matches the documented authority (code or root motion) in every state and ragdoll transitions restore control
checks.evidence: capture of each state transition with the authority recorded

risks.risk: Root motion and code movement both apply and double the displacement
risks.mitigation: Pick one authority per state and assert displacement in tests

artifacts.title: Addressables group and label plan with load and release ownership per asset
artifacts.purpose: Capability-specific deliverable for this catalog skill.

checks.statement: Every addressable loads and releases without leaking a handle, and the catalog resolves in a clean player build
checks.evidence: handle audit output plus a player build load/release cycle

risks.risk: Unreleased handles keep bundles in memory until the app is killed
risks.mitigation: Pair every load with a release and assert handle count returns to baseline

artifacts.title: Render pipeline asset settings per quality tier with the feature set each tier enables
artifacts.purpose: Capability-specific deliverable for this catalog skill.

checks.statement: Every shader and material renders correctly on each pipeline tier with no magenta or missing variants
checks.evidence: captures per pipeline tier plus the shader variant compilation log

risks.risk: A pipeline feature is assumed present but disabled in the quality tier
risks.mitigation: Verify the pipeline asset per tier and capture each tier explicitly

artifacts.title: Profiler capture set with scenario, hardware, and build id for each captured frame range
artifacts.purpose: Capability-specific deliverable for this catalog skill.

checks.statement: Frame time and GC allocation stay inside budget in a development build, measured on the declared minimum hardware
checks.evidence: profiler capture files with metadata headers

risks.risk: Editor numbers are used as release numbers
risks.mitigation: Capture in a development player build on target hardware and store metadata with every capture

artifacts.title: Blueprint asset ownership map with naming, folder, and review rules
artifacts.purpose: Capability-specific deliverable for this catalog skill.

checks.statement: Every Blueprint has a documented owner and folder convention, and logic that must be reviewable lives in C++ or a documented graph
checks.evidence: asset audit output listing owner and path per Blueprint

risks.risk: Blueprint graphs become unreviewable and unmergeable
risks.mitigation: Keep critical logic in C++ with Blueprint-exposed hooks and enforce naming/folder rules

artifacts.title: Widget hierarchy with CommonUI input routing and focus paths per platform
artifacts.purpose: Capability-specific deliverable for this catalog skill.

checks.statement: Menu navigation is complete with gamepad only, and widget focus never gets trapped after a back action
checks.evidence: gamepad-only navigation capture through every screen

risks.risk: CommonUI routing rules send input to the wrong widget layer
risks.mitigation: Document the input routing stack per screen and test gamepad-only traversal

artifacts.title: Niagara system inventory with effect budget, spawn rates, and cull distances
artifacts.purpose: Capability-specific deliverable for this catalog skill.

checks.statement: Effects stay inside the declared particle and overdraw budget in the worst-case scene, and every system has a low-spec fallback
checks.evidence: GPU and CPU timing captures with the effect count

risks.risk: Particle overdraw collapses frame time during combat
risks.mitigation: Budget particle count and overdraw per system and capture the worst case

artifacts.title: Signal connection matrix and typed resource contract sheet
artifacts.purpose: Capability-specific deliverable for this catalog skill.

checks.statement: No signal is connected twice, every connection has an owner, and typed resources reject malformed data with a visible error
checks.evidence: connection audit output plus a negative resource load test

risks.risk: Duplicate signal connections fire gameplay twice
risks.mitigation: Audit connections at scene load and assert count per signal in tests

artifacts.title: WebGL context configuration and fallback path (context attributes, loss handling, capability detection)
artifacts.purpose: Capability-specific deliverable for this catalog skill.

checks.statement: The renderer degrades to a documented fallback when a required extension is missing and recovers from a forced context loss
checks.evidence: capability probe output plus a forced context-loss capture

risks.risk: Context loss leaves a black screen with no recovery
risks.mitigation: Handle webglcontextlost/restored and test it by forcing the event

artifacts.title: Module graph with bundle boundaries and dependency versions
artifacts.purpose: Capability-specific deliverable for this catalog skill.

checks.statement: The built bundle runs from a static server with no console errors and no undeclared global leakage between modules
checks.evidence: console capture from the served build plus a globals check

risks.risk: Implicit globals and load-order coupling break after bundling
risks.mitigation: Use modules with explicit imports and run the bundle, not the sources

artifacts.title: Type boundary map (external data, DOM, engine APIs) with strictness settings
artifacts.purpose: Capability-specific deliverable for this catalog skill.

checks.statement: Type checking passes in strict mode with no untyped escape hatches on external data, and runtime validation guards every external boundary
checks.evidence: typecheck log plus validation tests against malformed external payloads

risks.risk: Types are assumed true at runtime and malformed saves crash the game
risks.mitigation: Validate external data at the boundary and keep strict mode on

artifacts.title: Scene and asset loading plan with preload boundaries and physics configuration
artifacts.purpose: Capability-specific deliverable for this catalog skill.

checks.statement: Every scene transitions without leaking timers or event listeners, and assets load in the declared order with failure handling
checks.evidence: scene transition capture plus a listener count before and after

risks.risk: Scene restarts accumulate listeners and slow the game down
risks.mitigation: Remove listeners on shutdown and assert listener counts in tests

artifacts.title: Scene graph and render loop budget (draw calls, materials, textures, disposals)
artifacts.purpose: Capability-specific deliverable for this catalog skill.

checks.statement: Draw calls and GPU memory stay inside budget, and every geometry, material, and texture is disposed when its scene unloads
checks.evidence: renderer info capture before and after unload

risks.risk: Disposal is skipped and GPU memory grows until the tab crashes
risks.mitigation: Track renderer.info and dispose explicitly on unload

artifacts.title: Babylon scene configuration with inspector evidence and asset container strategy
artifacts.purpose: Capability-specific deliverable for this catalog skill.

checks.statement: The scene renders within budget with the documented post-process chain, and inspector metrics confirm no orphaned meshes or materials
checks.evidence: inspector metric capture plus a mesh and material count assertion

risks.risk: Orphaned meshes accumulate across level loads
risks.mitigation: Assert mesh and material counts return to baseline after unload

artifacts.title: WASM module interface sheet (exports, imports, memory growth, threading)
artifacts.purpose: Capability-specific deliverable for this catalog skill.

checks.statement: The module loads with the declared memory limits, grows without corrupting state, and reports a clear error when the binary fails to instantiate
checks.evidence: instantiation log plus a memory growth test

risks.risk: Memory growth or a missing import kills the game with an opaque error
risks.mitigation: Test the largest declared workload and surface instantiation errors in the UI

artifacts.title: Service worker cache strategy with versioned precache and update path
artifacts.purpose: Capability-specific deliverable for this catalog skill.

checks.statement: The app updates cleanly to a new version without serving stale bundles, and the offline path serves a playable cached build
checks.evidence: update cycle capture plus an offline launch test

risks.risk: Users stay pinned to a stale cached build
risks.mitigation: Version the cache, skip waiting on update, and test the update path explicitly

artifacts.title: Game loop structure with event, update, draw separation and frame pacing configuration
artifacts.purpose: Capability-specific deliverable for this catalog skill.

checks.statement: The loop holds the declared frame rate with a fixed timestep for simulation, and window close, focus loss, and pause are handled
checks.evidence: frame time measurement over a fixed scenario plus a focus-loss capture

risks.risk: Simulation speed changes with frame rate on slower machines
risks.mitigation: Use a fixed timestep with interpolation and measure on a slow machine

artifacts.title: Sprite list and view layout with camera and draw-call configuration
artifacts.purpose: Capability-specific deliverable for this catalog skill.

checks.statement: Draw calls stay inside budget with the declared sprite count, and view switching resets camera state without a visual jump
checks.evidence: profiler capture with sprite counts plus a view switch capture

risks.risk: Per-sprite draw calls collapse performance at scale
risks.mitigation: Batch with sprite lists and measure with the target sprite count

artifacts.title: Panda3D task manager and render pipeline configuration sheet
artifacts.purpose: Capability-specific deliverable for this catalog skill.

checks.statement: Only the declared recurring tasks run per frame and the render pipeline delivers the target frame time on the minimum hardware
checks.evidence: task list dump plus a frame time capture

risks.risk: Accidental per-frame tasks multiply work every frame
risks.mitigation: Audit the task manager and measure frame time on the minimum target

artifacts.title: Entity hierarchy and update order specification
artifacts.purpose: Capability-specific deliverable for this catalog skill.

checks.statement: Entity update order is explicit and stable across frames, and enabling or disabling entities does not change unrelated behavior
checks.evidence: update order log across two frames plus enable/disable test

risks.risk: Implicit update order makes behavior frame-dependent
risks.mitigation: Declare update order and disable automatic updates where it matters

artifacts.title: Screen manager and widget tree specification with property binding map
artifacts.purpose: Capability-specific deliverable for this catalog skill.

checks.statement: Every screen transition is reversible and property bindings do not accumulate across visits
checks.evidence: screen cycle capture plus a binding count assertion

risks.risk: Bindings accumulate each visit and multiply callbacks
risks.mitigation: Unbind on leave and assert binding counts in tests

artifacts.title: Supported interpreter matrix with the exact tested versions and platform wheels
artifacts.purpose: Capability-specific deliverable for this catalog skill.

checks.statement: The game installs and starts on every declared interpreter version, and unsupported versions fail with a clear message instead of a traceback
checks.evidence: install and launch log per interpreter version plus the guard message

risks.risk: A dependency installs a broken wheel on an untested interpreter
risks.mitigation: Test every declared version in a clean environment and pin upper bounds

artifacts.title: Packaging recipe with entry point, bundled data files, and target runtime version
artifacts.purpose: Capability-specific deliverable for this catalog skill.

checks.statement: The packaged build runs on a machine without Python installed and includes every data file the game loads at runtime
checks.evidence: launch log from a clean machine plus a bundled-file listing

risks.risk: Data files are missing from the packaged build while the source run works
risks.mitigation: Build a listing of runtime-loaded files and verify it against the package

artifacts.title: Manual memory ownership sheet with allocation sites, lifetimes, and free paths
artifacts.purpose: Capability-specific deliverable for this catalog skill.

checks.statement: A sanitizer or leak checker run shows no leaks or invalid accesses across the declared test scenarios
checks.evidence: sanitizer or leak-check output with zero findings

risks.risk: Manual memory bugs appear only under load or on player machines
risks.mitigation: Run sanitizers in CI on the primary scenarios and fix every finding

artifacts.title: Language standard, ownership model (RAII, smart pointers), and exception policy declaration
artifacts.purpose: Capability-specific deliverable for this catalog skill.

checks.statement: The build is warning-clean with the declared standard, undefined-behavior sanitizers pass, and ownership rules hold in the reviewed diff
checks.evidence: build log with sanitizer results plus the ownership review note

risks.risk: Undefined behavior appears only at a different optimization level

artifacts.title: Deep-lane notes covering the specialist surface and its edge cases
artifacts.purpose: Documents the depth this capability is accountable for.

checks.statement: The specialist surface is exercised beyond the happy path, including at least one declared boundary condition and one failure case
checks.evidence: boundary and failure test captures

artifacts.title: Tool self-verification checklist
artifacts.purpose: Proves the tool checks itself before it is trusted.

checks.statement: The tool validates its own inputs and outputs and returns an actionable error, not a crash, on malformed input
checks.evidence: negative test transcript with messages

artifacts.title: Code-level design note with data flow and invariants
artifacts.purpose: Explains the implementation's structure before review.

checks.statement: Unit and integration tests pass and the implemented data flow matches the note, including stated invariants
checks.evidence: test output plus the invariant list

risks.risk: Implementation drifts from the documented data flow
risks.mitigation: Review the note against the diff and assert invariants in tests

artifacts.title: System diagram with instrumentation points
artifacts.purpose: Makes runtime behavior observable rather than guessed.

checks.statement: The system is instrumented (logs, counters, or traces) so its real behavior can be observed in a run without a debugger
checks.evidence: instrumented run log or trace

risks.risk: Behavior can only be inspected with a debugger attached
risks.mitigation: Add durable logs and counters and verify them in a normal run

artifacts.title: Documentation draft with stated audience and worked example
artifacts.purpose: Makes the document usable rather than merely complete.

checks.statement: A reader who is new to the project can follow the document to a working result without asking anyone
checks.evidence: a walkthrough test performed by someone who did not write it
